Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

Atop your Bastion, a telescope aimed at the night sky.

Observatory Charm. You can peer into the far corners of Wildspace and the Astral Plane. After you spend a Long Rest in your Observatory, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it, letting you cast Contact Other Plane without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

Empower: Eldritch Discovery. You or the hireling explore the eldritch mysteries of the stars for 7 consecutive nights. Then roll a die: on an even number, nothing happens; on an odd number, an unknown power grants you or another creature of your choice on your plane a Charm of Darkvision, Heroism, or Vitality.
